text:
rachel: Quick thread — Helix marketplace private-offer ask. Partner wants a combined commit+co-sell credit: 12% off committed usage, plus a one-time 6% co-sell rebate if the SI-led deployment completes within 45 days. We need marketplace copy, billing mapping, and a launch gating plan. Thoughts?

omar: Love the combo but two flags: (1) need a hard exposure cap on the SI rebate (suggest $40k) (2) partner co-sell rebate must be conditional on SI completion and signed acceptance form.

kevin: From billing: do not change SKUs. We'll apply two billing adjustments with tags: `credit:commit_discount` and `credit:si_rebate`. Example event we can accept: ```{"event_type":"credit_adjust","customer_id":"C-HELIX","offer_id":"HELIX-PVT-2026","tag":"si_rebate","amount_usd":24000,"cap_usd":40000,"applied_auto":false}``` For marketplaces that can't auto-apply, ops will set `applied_auto:false`.

sophie: Marketing/sales ask: hide the complex mechanics from the listing. Try headline: "Save up to 18% with committed usage + SI deployment incentives" and include an asterisk linking to T&Cs that explain timing and caps. Also, delay public listing until SI playbook is ready (2 weeks).

omar: Also add anti-gaming language: "rebates void if usage patterns indicate non-bona-fide activity or deliberate spikes." Legal can craft final text.

rachel: Good. For renewals: partner prefers a graduated early-renew credit (4% if renewed 60 days early, 2% if within 30 days). Doable?

kevin: Yes, but treat renewal credits as deferred rebates in accounting. We need `renewal_window` and `credit_decay` fields in the billing event. Sample: ```{"event_type":"credit_adjust","customer_id":"C-HELIX","offer_id":"HELIX-PVT-2026","tag":"early_renew","amount_usd":12000,"renewal_window":"60d","decay":"4pct->2pct"}``` We'll refine schema in PR.

sophie: Sales collateral: include an AE one-pager that shows example math for 3 ARR bands (100k, 300k, 1M) and sample savings. I can draft that.

partnerops-bot: Reminder: checklist incomplete: SI runbook, billing event PR, legal T&Cs, marketplace copy, partner-approved co-announcement date.

omar: Ops note: For partner reporting we should tag credits with `partner:helix` and `channel:marketplace` so reporting filters them out of baseline unit economics.

rachel: Action list: (1) Kevin: open billing PR with `cap_usd`, `applied_auto`, `partner` tags (2) Sophie: draft listing headline + AE math sheet + SI one-pager (3) Omar: draft anti-gaming phrasing and confirm ops gating (4) Rachel: propose co-announcement date after SI sign-off.

kevin: I'll open PR today and include a sample event plus notes about `applied_auto` behavior for AWS/GCP.

sophie: I'll drop drafts into the collateral doc by tomorrow AM.

omar: I'll loop in legal and partner-ops for gating.

partnerops-bot: Event scheduled: Helix launch final sync — 4209876900 (in 26m). Invitees: rachel, omar, kevin, sophie.

rachel: Thanks all. If no objections I'll lock the headline and caps after the sync.

sophie: No objections. :thumbsup:

kevin: LGTM.
